intent.text: I support the motion. From cost, one independent cross-family pass has bounded latency, tokens, and steward attention; a council adds synchronization and reconciliation overhead. The 43% versus 116/116 evidence makes the independent check likely to change action, so its marginal cost is justified. Keep escalation to a council conditional on concrete high-stakes or cross-domain trade-offs; otherwise it is review overhead without proportional decision value.
